name: RoulettePotV2 swapProfitFees sizes the LINK top-up from a spot quote
summary: RoulettePotV2.swapProfitFees is public and sizes each casino's LINK top-up with router.getAmountsIn over the LINK/WBNB pair's spot reserves, taking the shortfall from casino liquidity, then buys LINK with no minimum output. The attacker flash-borrowed 4,204 WBNB, bought 17,528 LINK out of the pair to inflate LINK's price, called swapProfitFees so the pot sold its casinos' tokens and spent 43.09 BNB on 21.27 LINK, then sold the LINK back into the pair.
notes: Casinos are created through the casino NFT contract and only carry liquidity; no owner setting after deployment made swapProfitFees exploitable, so the deployment is the reset.

No earlier exploit: of the 19 earlier swapProfitFees runs (SuppliedLink/SuppliedBNBP events since deployment), 17 were sent by the deployer and two by other accounts (one through Multicall3), each buying LINK at the market price; none followed the anchor.

Loss is the pot's depletion: BNBP has no DefiLlama price and is valued at the 37.79 BNB its in-transaction sale returned, at market before the LINK purchase; the 21.27 LINK went to the protocol's VRF subscription and is not subtracted.
